title: Compact series-overview mode + on-demand sparkline tooltip for time-series charts (a11y & perf tuning)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: High-density time-series views in the Console are slow on low-end devices and the current tooltip/legend patterns create noise for keyboard and screen-reader users. Goal: Introduce a compact 'series-overview' rendering mode that reduces DOM nodes and painting cost, and a low-bandwidth, keyboard-accessible 'on-demand sparkline tooltip' that only materializes detailed DOM when requested. Outcome should reduce p95 frame time and make keyboard/screen-reader interaction predictable without regressing visual clarity.
acceptance_criteria: Compact series-overview reduces rendered SVG/canvas overlays for hidden series and lowers typical paint cost by >=20% on mid-tier devices (benchmarked)
On-demand sparkline tooltip is discoverable via keyboard (focus key) and announced by screen readers with series name + value + delta
No visual regression for primary use cases (single-series focus, comparison mode) verified by visual diff tests
Design tokens used for colors/spacing referenced and documented in component spec
Engineering has a perf test harness and a rollback plan; can flip feature flag at route level
decision_log: 2025-02-13: Decided to prefer canvas-backed sparklines for overview rows to reduce DOM churn; keep primary interactive charts as hybrid SVG for hit-target precision.
2025-02-16: Opted for an explicit keyboard binding (Shift+K by default) to open on-demand tooltip to avoid interfering with existing chart focus behaviors.
2025-02-18: Agreed to expose a design-token flag (chart.compactSpacing) so product teams can opt into denser layouts without hard-coding spacing values.
2025-02-20: Engineering requested fallback to disabled animations when running under low-power/slow-device detection; design accepted.
2025-02-24: PM approved scope for MVP limited to list+detail routes; broader dashboard rollout deferred to follow-up.

Sofia Patel - Eng (2025-02-16): Suggested retaining a minimal DOM node per series for screen-reader targeting rather than serializing text inside canvas; will implement aria-hidden canvas + offscreen live region updates.

Liam O'Rourke (2025-02-26): Implemented feature flag and end-to-end tests. Performance dashboard shows 23% median paint reduction for overview routes on test cluster. Preparing PR review.

implementation_notes: Use canvas for bulk sparkline rendering; keep one lightweight <div role="listitem"> per series with aria-label for SRs
On-demand tooltip should be lazily mounted into a portal and receive focus; when mounted, send a GA event 'chart.tooltip_open'
Expose chart.compactSpacing and chart.legendGap tokens in theme; add mapping in tokens.json and document migration steps
Provide runtime check for reduced-motion and low-power devices to skip micro-animations
Add e2e perf smoke test that renders 500 series at 1s interval and measures frame time before/after
